about_the_game:
Sell Fate, One Relic at a Time

Welcome to Fortune Seller, a darkly weird roguelike about running an antique shop in a world where every deal could be your last and your days are numbered.
You’ve inherited a dusty little storefront and a mountain of debt. The landlord? Unforgiving. The rent? Rising every single week. Your only hope? Sell the right treasures to the right customers, and let the cards decide the rest.

Features

  • Hands-on Inventory Management
    Arrange your antiques Tetris-style to make the most of your limited storage space. Every slot matters, the wrong layout could cost you your life.

  • Sell What They Crave
    Read your customers, match their tastes, and score huge payouts. The better the match, the bigger your profit.

  • Tarot-Based Upgrades
    Draw cards between days to gain powerful new abilities. Choose wisely, the deck can bless or betray you.

  • Spiral into debt
    Weekly rent hikes keep the pressure high. Miss a payment, and your shops days are numbered.

  • Roguelike Replayability
    Unlock new tarot cards, unique powers, and eccentric playable characters to change your approach with every run.

Disclaimer: Fortune Seller has been machine-translated. We’re working hard to provide a higher-quality translation. Thank you for your support!

Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 6600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1050ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 12600 or equivalent
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GTX 1080ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended

short_description: A gothic roguelike shopkeeping game where you sell antiques, read the tarot, and manage your inventory to survive crushing rent increases. Match strange customers with the relics they crave, unlock powerful cards, and gamble your way out of debt, one deal at a time.
